test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Which of the following quotes is most apt for the passage?

options.text: Happiness and sadness run parallel to each other.
Happiness is a form of courage.
If you want happiness for a lifetime, help someone.
You can find happiness even in little things of life.

solution:
The correct answer is "**You can find happiness even in little things of life.**"
